initial_request:
Render every wave artifact from wave-state.json instead of having each agent hand-write HTML.

The second paragraph exists to prove paragraph splitting, and this <script> tag proves escaping.
next_action: Review result.html, then run /stx-checkin to commit.

features.title: Deterministic artifact rendering
acceptance_criteria: Running `stx-feature render <wave-dir>` writes every artifact with state behind it.
A rendered artifact contains no unresolved template tokens.
Re-running the renderer produces the same file apart from the timestamp.
features.existing_system_impact:
The Analyst, Architect and QA personas stop writing HTML entirely; their contracts end at wave-state.json.

The orchestrator gains one shell call after each hand-back. Nothing downstream of the artifacts changes.
